skins.name: Doctor of Faces
skins.description: Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, with a design concept more inclined towards the East, its main appeal is to highlight the wearer's personality. Onlookers can sense the simplicities and trends of Lungmen.

skins.name: Dusk Wisteria
skins.description: Handmade in Lungmen , tailor-fitted with special consideration to exotic design elements. The outfit has been improved in accordance with the customer's preference to incorporate Yan 's novel trends.

skins.name: Just a Driver
skins.description: Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, with a design concept more inclined towards the West, its main appeal being to create a balanced sense of uniform. Many fasteners adorn the outfit, reserving space for the client to personalize, mix and match.

skins.name: Tremble Cold
skins.description: Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, the typical clothing assembly process was refined in accordance with Ægir bodily characteristics, and the outfit displays a uniquely streamlined effect in turn. Color choices are made independently by the client.

skins.name: Unfettered Freedom
skins.description: Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, per the client's requests, twenty-four different designs of traditional women's clothing were drawn up, from which the client rolled dice to select one to ultimately be made into an outfit.
